materialization_methods_tested.description: Create tensors with no_alloc=false (immediate allocation), copy data via memcpy, compute, read back via direct memcpy from tensor->data

ggml_orientation_findings.ggml_mul_mat: computes Y = a @ b^T (TRANSPOSE matmul), Y_GGML[m,n] = sum_k a[m,k] * b[n,k]
ggml_orientation_findings.result_shape: [a->ne[1], b->ne[0]] = [rows of a, cols of b]
ggml_orientation_findings.result_tensor_buffer: nil after graph_compute, but tensor->data is valid
ggml_orientation_findings.square_residual_note: For K==N square residual: X[M,K].ne[0]=K, R[K,N].ne[0]=N, K==N -> mul_mat OK

negative_tests.ggml_backend_tensor_get_on_result_tensor: fails with GGML_ASSERT(buf != NULL) - result tensor has buffer=nil
negative_tests.no_alloc_true_with_backend_tensor_set: context tensor created with no_alloc=true but result tensor created by mul_mat has no buffer after compute

llama_graph_integration_recommendation.note: tensor->data is valid after context creation; can copy decoded F32 residual data directly into tensor buffer before graph build. Result tensor buffer=nil is fine for in-graph compute - GGML reads tensor->data directly during compute. No need for ggml_backend_tensor_get on result.
llama_graph_integration_recommendation.shape_requirements: Residual R[K,N] with square K==N: ne[0]=N, ne[1]=K. mul_mat requires K==N.
llama_graph_integration_recommendation.two_stage_note: Not needed with MethodA. Tensor data is valid immediately, no two-stage allocation required.

risks_and_limitations: Square residual (K==N) required - non-square residual needs reshape or transpose approach
ggml_backend_tensor_get does not work on result tensors - must use direct memcpy readback
Result tensor has buffer=nil after compute - this is GGML internal behavior, not a bug
Only tested on CPU backend - GPU/backend behavior may differ
next_recommended_phase: Phase 28BR-H: True injection integration - apply MethodA materialization to llama-graph.cpp attn_out injection point, use ggml_mul_mat for residual delta computation, test on actual model inference
